selection.rule: Lexicographically first two scenes in mini_train intersect full train; earliest four samples per scene ordered by (timestamp, token); no replacement

geometry.reference: Official reference LIDAR_TOP coordinate at its own ego pose; no point cloud input
geometry.official_range_filter: Strict XY center only, not a custom Z or visibility filter
geometry.preprocess: Official ResizeCropFlipImage(training=False), normalization and divisor32 padding; omit random GlobalRotScaleTransImage; GridMask off explicitly
geometry.camera_timestamps: Individual source sample_data timestamps and camera ego poses, not fabricated synchronous frames
geometry.velocity: Official adjacent annotation finite difference in global coordinates rotated to reference LiDAR; metadata-only adjacent reads

supervision.positive: Official Hungarian assignment of filtered ten-class GT
supervision.negative: Official unmatched-query detection supervision; not Occupancy Free
supervision.ignore: No inherited Bench2Drive blanket mask. Isolate any selected sample with an unresolved concrete supervision anomaly; do not replace it
supervision.raw_annotation_trace: Private per-annotation filtering reasons, including unsupported taxonomy, zero point support, out of XY range and invalid values
supervision.visual_review: All-object six-camera and BEV views for eight samples; actual viewer and inspected items recorded; unviewed content not human-approved

smoke.determinism_reason: Use J5C bounded validated FP32 setting; strict deterministic scalar indexing failed in original PETR and remains documented
smoke.frozen: All other parameters; backbone and neck in eval mode; exact before/after state_dict comparison includes buffers
smoke.dropout: Official head dropout unchanged; seeded RNG state recorded
smoke.fallback: None: no automatic size, class, range or precision change
smoke.save_reload: Private experiment checkpoint and optimizer; reload into same architecture, fixed eval input; atol 1e-6 rtol 1e-5; report actual errors
